citations.quote: ## Study AMX3500 (CENTAUR)
Study AMX3500 was a Phase 2 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study that randomized patients 2:1 to AMX0035 or placebo for 24 weeks.

design.text: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study, randomizing patients 2:1 to AMX0035 or placebo for 24 weeks, with an optional open-label extension (AMX3500OLE).

Patients were then allowed to participate in an optional, open-label extension study (AMX3500OLE) which followed patients on
This NDA provides for the use of Relyvrio (sodium phenylbutyrate and taurursodiol) for oral suspension for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) in adult patients.

endpoint.text: Prespecified primary endpoint was the rate of decline (slope) of the total ALSFRS-R score over the 24-week study period.

citations.quote: The primary efficacy endpoint for Study AMX3500 was the rate of decline (slope) of the total ALSFRS-R score.
Overall, Study AMX3500 demonstrated a statistically significant treatment benefit of AMX0035 compared to placebo on the prespecified primary endpoint, the rate of decline of ALSFRS-R.
Study AMX3500 is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study for 24 weeks intended to serve as the basis for the conclusion that AMX0035 is effective for the treatment of ALS.
In Study AMX3500, 137 patients were randomized 2:1 to receive AMX0035 (N = 89) or placebo (N = 48) for 24 weeks.

result.text: Statistically significant benefit on primary endpoint: LS mean ALSFRS-R total score 2.32 points higher at Week 24 vs placebo (95% CI 0.18, 4.47; p=0.0340). In a post hoc exploratory analysis of time to death alone at Week 132, the Applicant reports a nominally significant overall survival benefit (HR=0.64; median 23.5 vs 18.7 months; nominal p=0.0475).

citations.quote: The Applicant conducted a post hoc exploratory analysis of time to death alone at Week 132, as determined by vital status search data.

The Applicant reports a nominally significant overall survival benefit (HR = 0.64) in the ITT population, with longer median overall survival (23.5 months) in patients initially randomized to AMX0035 than the median overall survival of patients initially randomized to placebo (18.7 months) for a difference of 4.8 months in survival between arms. The apparent survival benefit has a nominal p-value of 0.0475.

summary.text: Traditional (non-accelerated) approval under 505(b)(1) with Priority Review and Orphan Drug designation, based on a single adequate and well-controlled Phase 2 study (AMX3500/CENTAUR) plus confirmatory evidence from long-term survival, applying regulatory flexibility for a serious, life-threatening disease with unmet need. Two Fast Track requests had been denied. The PCNS Advisory Committee, initially voting 6-4 against on March 30, 2022, was reconvened September 7, 2022, and voted 7-2 in favor of approval.

citations.quote: The applicant, Amylyx Pharmaceuticals, Inc., is seeking approval for AMX0035 (RELYVRIO) via 505(b)(1) pathway for the treatment of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) in adults.

Therefore, we conclude that the single, positive study, along with confirmatory evidence from the observed benefit on long-term survival, together demonstrate substantial evidence of effectiveness to support approval of AMX0035 for the treatment of ALS.

Priority or Standard	Priority
Submit Date(s)	October 29, 2021
AMX0035 for the treatment of ALS was granted orphan drug designation on July 27, 2017, and is exempt from PREA requirements.

Therefore, the Peripheral and Central Nervous System Advisory Committee (PCNS) was convened on March 30, 2022, to advise the Agency on the adequacy of the data to establish a conclusion of effectiveness for AMX0035.
The Committee voted 6-4 that the available data were not sufficient to establish a conclusion that AMX0035 is effective in the treatment of ALS.
As part of that review, the PCNS Advisory Committee was reconvened on September 7, 2022, to discuss the additional evidence that was submitted by the Applicant to provide confirmatory evidence.
The Committee Vote: YES: 7 NO: 2 Abstain: 0
